overallStatus: MILESTONE 1 COMPLETE; database connected; Layer B for 17 of 21 NYC stories; five-destination site built (first version) and awaiting user review.
method: Parsed the book's Bibliography (PDF pp. 372-434), which lists every story as "Kicker: Title" under chapter and subcategory, giving 125 entries.
Located each of the 125 stories in the main text (PDF pp. 20-363) and checked page order is monotonic.
Read the opening and closing passages of every story and the opening of every subcategory and chapter.
Scanned all story text for New York references to find SoHo/NYC-relevant material.
Layer B: web research on 2 stories only (58 Joralemon Street; Haughwout Building / Otis elevator).

Full-text review: the complete text of every story (83,508 words across 125 stories) was sliced from the PDF text layer, validated so each slice starts at its own kicker heading, and read in full in chapter order.

For every story the summary, function, historical context, takeaway, observation prompt, visual clues, places, figure/caption notes and related IDs were rewritten from the full text. Page ranges were checked against the sliced text (one correction: DISC-092 ends on PDF p.280, not 281).
Trailing photo captions and section teasers that sit after a story on its last page were identified (22) and recorded under bookReference.trailingNonStoryText so they are not mistaken for story text.
subcategoriesReviewed: all 25 subcategories: every story in each read in full
